    Radicals over a convex quotient #

    If P(z) lives on a convex T', the radical of the quotient projective at z restricts to rad P(z) (isoM_res_radP).

    source

    IsoM (D.RadP z) (resFD (D.qmap T') ((D.quot hT).RadP z))
